items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: SK Hynix reported record Q3 operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, beating estimates as AI chip demand surged. The Nvidia supplier plans $75.4 billion in shareholder returns. ... South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. items.title: SK Hynix Breaks Ground on Critical Nvidia Supply Play
items.author: Moz Farooque ACCA
items.highlights: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) is putting another major piece of the AI supply chain on U.S. soil, breaking ground Thursday on an approximately $4 billion high-bandwidth memory packaging and research complex in West Lafayette, Indiana. The project matters to investors because HBM has emerged as one of the most critical components inside Nvidia-powered AI systems, and SK Hynix is betting demand will remain strong enough to justify substantially more capacity through the end of the decade. items.highlights: 【财新网】 AI算力需求兑现为芯片厂商业绩。三季度，韩国存储巨头SK海力士（KRX:000660；NASDAQ:SKHY）单季营收首次突破100万亿韩元，营业利润同比增长逾六倍，并以长约形式提前锁定2027年至2028年的过半产能。 当地时间10月28日，海力士发布2026年第三季度业绩，营收104.6万亿韩元，同比增长328%，环比增长32%；营业利润83.33万亿韩元，同比增长632%，营业利润率为80%；净利润39.78万亿韩元，同比增长216%，较二季度下滑58%。
